references.text: Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights, the same time period mentioned here.
God gave Moses the two stone tablets, written with God's finger, which parallels the receiving of the covenant tablets.
The description of the two tablets of the testimony that were written on both sides, the work of God and the writing of God.
Moses was with the Lord for forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water, and the Lord wrote the words of the covenant on the tablets.
The Lord proclaimed his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he wrote on two stone tablets.
These words the Lord spoke to the entire assembly on the mountain, and he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses.
The description of the new stone tablets that replaced the first ones, and that they were placed in the ark.
In the ark there was nothing else but the two stone tablets that Moses laid down there at Horeb.
The ark of the covenant containing the stone tablets with the covenant, mentioned in connection with the holy objects of the tabernacle.
